title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Relief of the Substitution Partial Claim Reserve by Disability Compensation Rating
content:
On a restoration of a seller's VA Home Loan Guaranty entitlement by substitution, the partial claim reserve is relieved according to the combined rating of the seller's Disability Compensation award.

## Relief

| The seller's Disability Compensation award | Reserve relief |
|---|---|
| Combined rating of at least 50 percent | The higher reserve relief, 50 percent |
| Combined rating below 50 percent but at least 30 percent | The lower reserve relief, 25 percent |
| Otherwise (below 30 percent, or no award) | Not relieved (0) |

Relieving the reserve by a percentage means the reserve is multiplied by one minus that percentage divided by one hundred. The higher relief rating is 50 and the lower relief rating is 30; a rating equal to a threshold falls on that threshold's row.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical reserve of 6,000.00 dollars)

| Combined rating | Relief | Reserve after relief |
|---|---|---|
| 70 | 50 | 3,000.00 |
| 50 | 50 | 3,000.00 |
| 40 | 25 | 4,500.00 |
| 30 | 25 | 4,500.00 |
| 20 | 0 | 6,000.00 |
| No award | 0 | 6,000.00 |
